'''Anoser''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Iziz ruling family|Onderon Royal Family]] and, together with her brother [[Anosek]], she was a cousin to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Third Galactic War|renewed Galactic War]], a galactic conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay Alternatives===
====Supporting the Empire====
During the [[Sith Empire|Imperial]] storyline for ''Onslaught'', the player character is tasked with eliminating Anoser and [[Anosek]] in an attempt to infuriate King [[Regalun Petryph]] into rallying his supporters against the Republic in an attack on the capital [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] so he can reclaim his throne. The player character can either kill them both or take them as prisoners.<ref name="Onslaught" />

====Supporting the Republic====
While the fates of the cousins are not detailed during the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] storyline, [[Lana Beniko]] brings up the idea of the cousins being potential replacements for who becomes ruler when Petryph is deposed, but laments that they aren't proper material for such a role.<ref name="Onslaught" />
